name: Astoria (Clatsop Plains dune ridges)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours; same keys as pnw.json plus F0-F2). Astoria Golf & Country Club, Warrenton OR: irrigated fairways in the hollows between parallel dune ridges, the rough on the ridges left to dry to a warm tawny in summer (F0-F2; the whole rough, with a mown green band beside the fairways from config rough_band_m), grey-white coastal sand, dark tannin water (Sunset Lake), near-black Sitka spruce and shore pine (assets-src/trees_astoria.py). Hues from the OSIP 2024 photo of the course (fairway #8a9d6e, dry rough #aba486, sand #cbc5ba, lake #323b3e, conifers #384140), saturated for the game's style; the tawny is warmer and pinker than Gearhart's olive straw. Off the course (L0-L2) stays an olive green so out of bounds reads apart from the rough. Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
